description: Proposed wrap-around ground floor rear extension, following the demolition of an existing extension,  proposed rear extension at the second floor level and minor alterations to the rear fenestration.
decision_conditions:
FLAT ROOF NOT USED AS AMENITY SPACE (COMPLIANCE): Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), the use of the flat roof of the second floor extension hereby approved (as shown on approved drawing 346 103) shall be as set out in the application and no development (including the formation of any door) providing access to the roof shall be carried out, nor shall the roof area be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area in perpetuity.
 
REASON: To prevent the undue overlooking of neighbouring habitable room windows and neighbouring gardens and protect neighbouring amenity in accordance with Policy PLAN1 of Islington’s Strategic and Development Management Policies (2023).
